# SiteSupply sample data

**This data is synthetic.** It was generated by `scripts/make_sample_data.py` (seed 42) and covers 25 weeks, from 6 Apr to 27 Sep 2026. It does not describe any real company, vendor or customer.

| File | Rows | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| orders.csv | 1,158 | one row per order, with timestamps, quantities, distance, outcome flags, risk-score points and alert |
| enquiries.csv | 3,166 | each enquiry, and whether it was quoted and ordered |
| vendors.csv | 12 | Vendor A to Vendor L: materials, price index, zone, join date |
| customers.csv | 300 | builders and contractors, one project site each |
| materials.csv | 6 | material, unit and quantity range |
| stats_summary.json | – | every statistic used on the site (from `scripts/analysis.py`) |
| vendor_stats.csv, weekly_otif.csv | – | helper outputs from the analysis |

## Planted patterns (on purpose)

| Pattern | How it was planted |
|---|---|
| Vendors G and K are unreliable | +1.0 and +0.9 on the log-odds of being late; 12% short-delivery chance (others 5%) |
| ...and cheaper | price index 0.95, so they win more orders |
| Monsoon delays | +0.8 log-odds from June to September; late orders are also 30% longer |
| Long routes | +0.6 log-odds when the distance is over 50 km |
| Rush orders | +0.7 log-odds when the order is placed under 24 h before need (about 18% of orders) |
| Ready-mix concrete | +0.3 log-odds (small, and not detected at this sample size) |
| Late or short delivery reduces demand | the customer's enquiry rate is ×0.6 for 30 days afterwards |
| New vendor | Vendor L joins on 3 Aug 2026 |
| Dispatch signal | 80% of late orders leave the plant late; 20% leave on time and are delayed on the road |

## Key columns in orders.csv

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `promised_ts` | the agreed delivery time |
| `dispatch_planned_ts` / `dispatch_actual_ts` | when the truck should have left / when it did leave |
| `check_ts` | planned dispatch + 1 h, when the full risk score is computed |
| `on_time`, `in_full`, `otif` | 1/0 outcome flags; blank for cancelled orders |
| `vendor_recent_otif` | the vendor's OTIF over its last 10 orders delivered **before** `check_ts`, so the score never sees the future |
| `pts_*`, `risk_score`, `alert` | the rule-based score (alert = score ≥ 50) |
| `alert_lead_hours` | promised time − check time, for orders that got an alert |
